mike_h: Heads up — canary for model-embed-v2 is at 12% and dashboards show 95th latency jumping from 120ms -> 420ms for /v1/embed. Rolling back plan?

sara_p: Ugh. Is it correlated with a quantized variant rollout or routing policy change?

jordan: Telemetry shows increased tail only on region eu-west1 and only traffic routed via routing-policy B (A/B split). Not global.

mike_h: OK — propose we do a quick route-disable for the canary path instead of full revert to avoid cold-starts. Steps: 1) flip guard flag to block new canary traffic, 2) drain existing sessions with affinity TTL 120s, 3) invalidate KV prefix for embeddings for affected model version.

randy_g: Agree. Fast revert (`redwoodctl rollout abort --id=r-20240328-embed-v2`) would be higher blast (model swap). Safer to disable route: `redwoodctl routing set-policy --name=embed-ab --split=88:12 -> 100:0` and then patch guard: `redwoodctl guard set --canary=false --id=embed-ab --reason="latency spike"`

deploy-bot: @channel detected anomaly: canary r-20240328-embed-v2 latency > 3x baseline. Suggested action: route disable + kv-sweep.

ops-bot: Running preflight for safe-disable: verifying active sessions, checking KV leases, ensuring fallback model available.

sara_p: Important: KV invalidation can cause hot misses. Prefer a prefix TTL sweep: `POST /internal/kv/sweep` with body `{"prefix":"embed_v2_cache/", "dry_run":false, "batch_size":500}`. Set `batch_size` small to avoid IOPS spikes.

jordan: Also add a temporary quota throttle on canary tokens to cap impact while draining: `quotactl update embed-ab --rate=50/s`. That keeps backend healthy.

mike_h: I'll run the route flip and throttle now. Jordan — can you run the KV sweep once route is at 0%? Sara — please update the rollout dashboard (canary status) and mark the incident note.

jordan: On it. I'll wait for your signal to start sweep.

randy_g: Reminder: record the rollback reason in the rollout metadata so A/B metrics can be auto-annotated for later analysis.

mike_h: Done: route sets applied, canary traffic now 0%. Starting 2-min drain window. If we see errors or cost spike, plan B is immediate full revert. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollout update: embed-ab split changed to 100:0 by mike_h at 1709123580

ops-bot: preflight checks OK. KV sweep queued (dry_run=false) — estimated time ~6m with batch_size=500.

sara_p: Thanks. I pushed a note to the rollout timeline and added a quick grafana panel for canary vs baseline latency.

jordan: Sweep started. Monitoring for sudden cache misses and error rates.

mike_h: If anything spikes, shout here and I'll trigger `redwoodctl rollback --fast` (we prefer avoiding but it's available).

randy_g: Solid. After KV sweep completes, let's validate model outputs on a sampled prompt set before unfreezing the canary. :thumbsup:

mike_h: Sweep completed, no error surge, latency trending down. Closing this thread once we confirm 30m stable. Thanks all. :shipit:
